meta.title: About Us
meta.description: Market Balance Co., Ltd. is a global business partner whose field-proven specialists run overseas exhibitions, export marketing and buyer sourcing & matching.

hero.label: Page header
description: Market Balance goes beyond overseas marketing outsourcing —
we help your business find its ideal balance in the global market.

vision.label: Vision
vision.description: Our specialists bring hands-on experience from fields at home and abroad, delivering exhibitions as well as market research, export consultations, buyer sourcing and matching, conferences, investor relations events, roadshows and overseas marketing consulting.
vision.quote: From planning and budgeting to execution, we stay open and attentive to our clients — and remain your overseas marketing partner all the way through.
points: A steady balance in the global market
Systematic localization strategies that deliver results
Tailored solutions built on deep experience

items.label: 20+ years of hands-on experience
items.desc: Our CEO's extensive background in export marketing, exhibitions and conventions gives us distinctive know-how and proven problem-solving ability.

items.label: Overseas marketing specialists
items.desc: Each project is run by a dedicated team of specialists with at least 10 years of on-site MICE experience and a global perspective.

items.label: A wide global network
items.desc: Through partners in some 20 countries across the Americas, Europe, China, Vietnam and beyond, we deliver strategies tailored to each market.

items.label: Distinctive international event planning
items.desc: We plan and run more than 20 large-scale international events a year, including overseas buyer invitations, export consultations and trade missions.

items.label: Precise buyer sourcing & matching
items.desc: We precisely target leading buyers in advanced industries such as ICT, bio and renewable energy, delivering business matches with a high success rate.

items.title: Result-Oriented
items.subtitle: Results over events
items.desc: We aim for tangible results, not just events. From objective analysis to strategy, operation, performance review and follow-up business, we run one continuous cycle.

items.title: Customized Strategy
items.subtitle: Strategies built for you
items.desc: More than an agency, we build global market-entry strategies tailored to each company and industry — from market diagnosis to an execution roadmap.

items.title: Global Network
items.subtitle: A strong global network
items.desc: We maintain regional offices and strong partnerships with marketing specialists in some 20 countries, including China, Southeast Asia, Russia, India, the Americas and Europe.

items.title: Trust & Transparency
items.subtitle: Trust and transparency
items.desc: With an open mind toward our clients, we put transparent and honest partnership first — from planning and budgeting to execution and reporting.
